name: @unicarehealth/ts-exif-parser
description: Reads Exif metadata from JPEG images, in Node.js, Bun, browsers and NetSuite
//: scripts: TypeScript 6 and TypeScript 7 both provide binaries, so we run TypeScript 7's tsc by its path, through Bun, as Windows can't run its shebang line.
devDependencies: We use TypeScript 7 for tsc, but TypeScript 7 doesn't have an API yet, so we need 'typescript' to resolve to TypeScript 6 for typescript-eslint.

scripts.build: bun run build:clean && bun run build:js && bun run build:types
scripts.build:js: bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --target browser --format esm --sourcemap=linked
scripts.lint: bun run lint:tsc && bun run lint:eslint && bun run lint:npm-package-json-lint
scripts.release-major: bun run lint && bun run test && npm version major && bun run release:publish
scripts.release-minor: bun run lint && bun run test && npm version minor && bun run release:publish
scripts.release-patch: bun run lint && bun run test && npm version patch && bun run release:publish
scripts.release:publish: bun run build && bun publish && git push --follow-tags
